status: fixed implementation of the frozen transportability block

reliability.method: partial identification under source and destination reliabilities bounded from 0.10 to 1.00

k562_diagnostics.outcome: median observed signed-profile Pearson correlation across the three CD4 comparisons
k562_diagnostics.rerouted: top decile of complete-target mean rerouting under the existing S24 rule
k562_diagnostics.invariant: bottom decile of complete-target mean rerouting with constant transfer class under the existing S24 rule
k562_diagnostics.molecular_predictor: fraction of response edges with at least two of curated, motif, or active physical-link support

rpe1_developmental_diagnostic.outcome: absolute error in log1p differentially expressed genes
rpe1_developmental_diagnostic.inner_folds: five deterministic SHA256 target folds within each training set
rpe1_developmental_diagnostic.calibration_split: one deterministic SHA256 fifth of each outer training set

selection_directions.uncertainty_only: ascending disagreement between frozen full and vector-ablated predictions
selection_directions.reliability_only: descending mean of available source guide and donor concordance

guide_source.summary: final validated guide-concordance output; efficacy is the median absolute CD4 knockdown across guides and states

decision_rule: H7-H11 cannot pass without target-level external reliability where required, three compatible external systems for leave-one-system-out applicability, and a genuinely untouched external system
